description: This file declares the WebAudioPlayerTaskFactory class, which implements the IWebAudioPlayerTaskFactory interface. It provides factory methods to create various WebAudioPlayer tasks such as play, pause, stop, setCaps, eos, setVolume, writeBuffer, and handleBusMessage, for the WebAudioPlayer component in the Rialto server. The class holds references to client and wrapper objects needed for task creation.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerTaskFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating WebAudioPlayer tasks such as play, pause, stop, setCaps, eos, setVolume, writeBuffer, and handleBusMessage, used within the Rialto server's WebAudioPlayer component.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerTaskFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with client and wrapper dependencies.

methods.name: createShutdown
methods.description: Creates a task to shut down the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createStop
methods.description: Creates a task to stop the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createPlay
methods.description: Creates a task to start playback on the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createPause
methods.description: Creates a task to pause playback on the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createSetCaps
methods.description: Creates a task to set the media capabilities (e.g., MIME type, configuration) for the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createEos
methods.description: Creates a task to signal end-of-stream for the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createSetVolume
methods.description: Creates a task to set the volume level of the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createWriteBuffer
methods.description: Creates a task to write audio buffer data to the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createHandleBusMessage
methods.description: Creates a task to handle bus messages from GStreamer related to the WebAudioPlayer.
